directed_utterances.utterance_text: I think that's the part I struggle with most — believing I'm capable of handling it, because my track record lately feels like a lot of falling apart at family dinners and avoiding phone calls from people who want to check in on me. But I notice I'm already trying to argue myself out of what I just felt, which I guess is kind of proving your point in a frustrating way. I'll try to hold onto it, even if some part of me is already waiting for Sunday to prove me wrong.
